name: Currency Intl
description: Formats amounts according the locales of users using the PHP Intl extension.
project_description:
This module provides your website with currency conversion, currency information & metadata, and amount/price display functionality.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 For end users:
 
 Currency conversion page 
 Currency conversion input filter 
 Amount/price display input filter 
 
 
 API (features for other modules)
 
 Currency information & metadata 
 Pluggable currency conversion API. Ships with custom and historical fixed rates. Also supports Yahoo! Finance . 
 Tokens 
 Amount/price form element 
 Currency Views handlers 
 Amount/price Views field handler 
 
 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 
 PHP 5.5/7.0 or higher, with BC Math . 
 Composer 
 Plugin
